# Title

> Displays the title of a post, page, or any other content-type.

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/post-title`
**Category:** theme
**API Version:** 3
**Block Type:** Dynamic (server-rendered)

> Displays the title of a post, page, or any other content-type.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `level` | `number` | `2` | — |
| `levelOptions` | `array` | — | — |
| `isLink` | `boolean` | `false` | Role: `content` |
| `rel` | `string` | `""` | HTML attr: `rel`. Role: `content` |
| `linkTarget` | `string` | `"_self"` | Role: `content` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | — |

## Supports

- **anchor**: `true`
- **align**: `"wide"`, `"full"`
- **html**: `false`
- **color**:
  - gradients: `true`
  - link: `true`
- **spacing**:
  - margin: `true`
  - padding: `true`
- **typography**:
  - fontSize: `true`
  - lineHeight: `true`
  - textAlign: `true`
- **interactivity**:
  - clientNavigation: `true`

## Context

**Uses context:**

- `postId`
- `postType`
- `queryId`

## Block Markup

This is a **dynamic block**. It is rendered on the server and does not save HTML in post content.

In post content, it is stored as a block comment:

```html
<!-- wp:post-title {"level":2,"isLink":false,"rel":"","linkTarget":"_self"} /-->
```
